fields.value: Transit Station Air Quality, Accessibility and Rider Wellbeing in the Greater Toronto Area, 2019-2023

datasetContactAffiliation.value: School of Cities, University of Toronto

dsDescriptionValue.value: Three waves of linked environmental and survey data collected at ten rapid transit stations across the Greater Toronto Area. Each wave pairs monthly air quality readings from nearby fixed monitors with a repeated rider survey covering mental wellbeing and travel behaviour, and with walkshed measures of accessibility and tree canopy. The deposit contains raw monitor readings, the processed station-year panel used in the published analysis, the cleaning scripts, and the figures reproduced in the paper. Participant-level survey responses are restricted under the ethics protocol; the aggregated panel is openly available.
Note on coverage: no fieldwork took place in 2020, and the planned 2022 wave was folded into 2023 following a funding gap. Analyses treating the waves as evenly spaced will be wrong.

publicationCitation.value: Okonkwo, A., Tremblay, M.-E., & Chaudhry, S. (2024). Station-level exposure and rider wellbeing across three waves. Journal of Transport & Health, 36, 101823.
Chaudhry, S. (2023). Walkshed construction for transit exposure studies: a methods note. Urban Data Review, 8(2), 44-51.
